answer: LIST street, city, zip, state FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO has SchoolStreet street AND ALSO has SchoolCity city AND ALSO has SchoolZip zip AND ALSO has SchoolState state AND ALSO (g / t) AS rate WHERE t > 0 ORDERED WITH rate ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n FROM Frpm [has FrpmSchoolType: 'State Special Schools'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k ORDERED WITH k DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolGSoffered g AND ALSO has SchoolLongitude lo ORDERED WITH lo DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, doc FROM Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType doc AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a WHERE (k - a) > THE AVERAGE d IN (Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS d)
LIST n FROM Frpm has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmPercentEligibleFreeK12 p AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE p > 0.1 AND g > 0

LIST county, c FROM School s [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty county AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s GROUPED BY county AS c WHERE county = 'San Diego' OR county = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH c DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
